test_accuracy_modular_addition.assessment: FAIL: 3.88% vs baseline 45.32%. Candidate is 11.7x worse.

compute_to_threshold_ratio.assessment: FAIL: Neither candidate nor baseline reached 99% threshold. Candidate never exceeded 9.4% test accuracy.

gradient_health_mean_norm.assessment: PASS: Gradient norms remained healthy throughout training. No exploding gradients.

param_efficiency_params_per_accuracy_poi.assessment: MISLEADING: Lower ratio due to tiny model (1383 params) with near-zero accuracy. Not a meaningful advantage.

reaches_99pct_with_less_compute.detail: Test accuracy reached only 3.88%. Target was 99%. Not close.

maintains_performance_across_primes.detail: Severe per-prime variance. p=5: 53.8%, p=7: 28.0%, p=13: 20.0%, all primes >= 11 (except 13) near or below random chance.

higher_accuracy_per_flop_than_baseline.detail: Baseline achieved 45.32% test accuracy. Candidate achieved 3.88%. Baseline dominates at every compute level.

gradient_explosion.detail: Max gradient norm was 0.040. Never exceeded 50.

below_60pct_at_half_budget.detail: At epoch 5000 (50% of budget), test accuracy was 3.8%. Far below 60% threshold.

loss_above_initial_at_20pct_budget.detail: Initial train loss 3.189. At epoch 2000 (20% budget), train loss was 2.566. Loss did decrease.

training_dynamics_diagnostic.description: Train accuracy oscillated between 13-24% for first 3000 epochs with no clear upward trend. Around epoch 3000, training partially collapsed (train accuracy dropped to 12%, test to 3%). Post-collapse, the model slowly recovered train accuracy to ~16% but test accuracy remained stuck at 3-4% with steadily rising test loss, indicating severe overfitting on memorized patterns.
training_dynamics_diagnostic.train_test_divergence: Extreme. Test loss grew from 3.2 to 9.5 while train loss decreased from 3.2 to 2.8. The model memorized a subset of training data without learning generalizable structure.
training_dynamics_diagnostic.per_prime_pattern: Only p=5 (53.8%) showed meaningful learning, suggesting the CRT decomposition captures mod-5 residue structure but fails to compose it for larger primes. p=7 (28%) and p=13 (20%) showed weak partial learning. All primes >= 17 were at or below random chance.

reject_reasons: Primary metric 11.7x worse than baseline (3.88% vs 45.32%)
Failure criterion #2 triggered: test accuracy 3.8% at 50% compute budget (threshold: 60%)
Severe per-prime generalization failure: only p=5 above random
Extreme train-test divergence indicating memorization without generalization
